title: Supreme Court declines urgent hearing of plea on Ram Mandir donation theft
description: The Supreme Court on Monday declined urgent hearing in a public interest litigation (PIL) seeking a probe by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) into the financial irregularities and missing funds at the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya.
